message:
🚀 Flex GUI Pro — Version 5.2.2 Official Release Notes
This stable release delivers critical performance optimizations and layout corrections, specifically resolving underlying instabilities within the Shakes Panel and the Text Manipulation Engine.

🛠️ Performance Fixes & Stability Upgrades
1. Shakes Panel Optimization
Preset Initialization Fix: Resolved an issue where applying custom camera shakes (such as Warp, Wave, or Lens) would occasionally drop keyframes or fail to initialize correctly on complex multi-layer compositions.

Slider Boundary Calibration: Fixed a calculation error in the Speed and Strength sliders to ensure perfectly smooth, responsive data mapping without visual clipping.

2. Text Manipulation Engine Corrective Patch
Split-Mode Render Fix: Resolved a critical bug within the Text Exploder and Fonts Tab where isolating text by Characters, Words, or Paragraphs would cause layout breaking or text layer displacement under specific paragraph alignments.

Live Preview Synchronization: Fixed real-time rendering delays inside the text canvas preview window, ensuring immediate visual feedback when switching between active composition layers.

➕ Re-introducing Core V5.2.0 Ecosystem Features
3. Universal Layer Saving & AE Syncing
Universal Layer Support: Comp Saver completely supports saving individual selections of any layer type (Vector Shapes, Adjustment Layers, Text, Solids, or Nulls) directly to your library without forcing a precomposition.

Label Color Syncing: UI elements inside the asset grid now automatically render left border tags and top-left indexing dots that match your native After Effects layer label colors perfectly.

Real-Time Database Search: A clean search input bar filters your saved layout blocks and composition assets instantaneously as you type.

4. Interactive Task Architecture
Integrated Notepad Overlay: Features an auto-saving production notepad and an interactive task checklist mapping row creations directly to the Enter key.

Draggable Task Bubble: A floating interface utility that anchors above your active workspace panels to keep your immediate project milestones visible from any layout orientation.

5. High-Definition Global Media Downloader
High-Fidelity Stream Merging: Bypasses legacy resolution fallbacks to automatically fetch and compile top-tier stream configurations.

Automated Environment Setup: Instantly detects missing system dependencies and auto-downloads static matching binaries to enable immediate high-definition media rendering on Apple Silicon, Intel Mac, and Windows environments out of the box.

All core ExtendScript library dependencies, HTML signatures, and internal line verification hashes have been systematically updated and validated for stable deployment.
